title: Inheritance-Calculus Schema
description: The abstract syntax tree of inheritance-calculus, written directly rather than derived from the MIXINv2 schema, which this paper treats as a sugared superset. A program is a single mixin. Relative to MIXINv2 this core admits no syntactic sugar: every object has exactly one property, and a reference may occur only as a member of a mixin, never directly as a property value, so a bare reference value must be wrapped as a singleton member list. It also has no scalar leaves: the leaf values string, number, boolean, and null that MIXINv2 supplies through its foreign-function interface are not part of inheritance-calculus.

lexicalReference.description: A lexical reference: a projection list of labels, resolved by searching the enclosing scopes for the leading label.

qualifiedThisReference.description: A reference with a qualified this [Scope, ~, labels...], which names an enclosing scope explicitly and then projects. In YAML the ~ is null and marks the qualified this.

reference.description: An inheritance source: either a lexical reference or a reference with a qualified this.

definition.description: A single property: an object with exactly one key, the defined label, whose value is the defined mixin.

mixin.description: A mixin: a member list, a sequence whose members are definitions and references. The empty sequence is the empty mixin.
